phases.goal: backend/Cargo.toml carries no unused dependencies and documents the ones it deliberately keeps.
CI workflow env/tooling carries three small, independent, low-risk fixes: leaner cache, prebuilt cargo-audit, no spurious release failures.
Per-PR CI stops running unenforced performance-gate theater; Lighthouse becomes a real, on-demand, non-theater check.
Rust toolchain version and link step are single-sourced and faster, with an opt-in path to bigger/native runners.
The Rust crate compiles once per CI run; clippy and test no longer each pay a full recompile of the crate plus the heavy vendored ruvector path crates.
The Docker build context actually contains everything the runtime target needs to compile - the ruvector submodule is no longer silently missing.
definition_of_done: cmd: docker buildx build --target runtime -f backend/Dockerfile --load -t emailibrium-backend:spec-check .
